messages.content:
Subject: Vulnerability disclosure: file download

I found that attachment download URLs are signed but the signature doesn't include the expiry, so a leaked URL works forever. I haven't used this beyond my own test files. Please let me know how you'd like me to share the details.

Subject: Deletion certificate

Our workspace was deleted last week at our request. For our ISO 27001 records, we need a certificate or written confirmation of data destruction, including backups. Could you provide that? Former org ID 30912.

Subject: How to create a template

How do I turn one of our projects into a template so we can reuse the structure for each new client? And will the template keep the assignees or will I need to set those each time?
Our webhook endpoint was down for about 6 hours yesterday. Do you retry failed deliveries? And if so, for how long? We need to know if we missed events or if they'll come through.
The product is good but the support chat closes before I finish typing my question. Happened 3 times. Frustrating.

Subject: Feedback: love it, but...

We absolutely love the product, but please stop sending us marketing emails about features we already use. We get three a week. Otherwise perfect.
Box integration: can't attach any files, error "insufficient scope". We reconnected and approved all permissions. Worked until last month.
our invoice this month has an "Advanced Reporting add-on" for $25 that nobody on our team ordered. please remove it and refund. acct_pp20x9

Subject: Webhook signature verification failing

We're verifying webhook signatures per the docs (HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body with our signing secret) but every event since yesterday's key rotation fails verification. Our code:

    expected = hmac.new(secret, raw_body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, header_sig): reject()

We rotated the secret in the dashboard at ~14:00 UTC. Is the old secret still being used on your side? Example delivery ID: evt_01J9ZK4QX2. Events are piling up in our dead-letter queue.

Subject: Stop renewing

Stop the renewal please. Account acct_rr8q02. That's all.

Subject: Integration: Linear

Do you integrate with Linear? We'd like issues in Linear to link to tasks here. If there's no native integration, is the API flexible enough for us to build it ourselves?

Subject: Dashboard timeouts

Our executive dashboard has 12 widgets. Since last week, half of them time out and show "Could not load data" on the first load, then work after a refresh. It's embarrassing when I open it in front of our CEO. Is there a way to make it load reliably?

Subject: Mobile app huge storage

The Android app is using 4.2 GB of storage on my phone. I don't have that many attachments. Is there a way to clear cached files without losing offline data? My phone keeps saying storage is full.

Subject: Evaluation for our agency network

Hi there,

I'm the COO of a network of seven independent creative agencies (about 320 people in total) that share some back-office functions. Each agency currently picks its own tools, and we'd like to standardise on one project management platform.

The tricky part is that each agency needs to stay separate: its own workspace, its own clients, its own admin. But we'd like one contract, one invoice, and some cross-agency reporting at group level, like utilisation and project margins.

Is that kind of structure possible with your Enterprise plan? If so, could you outline roughly how pricing would work (per agency or total seats?), and whether group-level reporting would need custom work.

I'd appreciate a call with someone who has worked with similar groups. Our finance director would join too.

Thanks,
Theo Lindqvist
COO, Meridian Creative Collective
I cancelled my subscription last month. Now I'd like my account deleted too. Is that a separate step? I don't want any of my data kept.
Charged in AUD this month instead of USD like always. Amount is also higher. Invoice INV-65340. What happened?

We downgraded from annual Business to annual Pro halfway through the year. Do we get the price difference back for the remaining 6 months, or as account credit? Credit is fine if refunds aren't possible. Org ID 32906

Subject: Disappointed

I've been a customer since 2019 and I've always recommended you to friends. But the last few months have been frustrating. Support replies take days, the new pricing page is confusing, and features I relied on moved behind the Business plan. I'm not cancelling yet, but I wanted someone there to know how it feels from this side. I hope someone actually reads this.

I'm on the Personal plan and I just started a small business with a partner. Can I upgrade my plan to a Team plan and invite her, or do I need a separate account? I'd like to keep all my existing projects.

Subject: Security questionnaire for tender

Dear Sales and Security teams,

We're a public sector organisation in the Netherlands, and we're running a formal tender for a project management platform. Your company has been invited to submit a proposal.

As part of the tender, all bidders must complete the attached security and privacy questionnaire (which I'll send once you confirm a contact) and provide:
- ISO 27001 certification, with the scope statement
- A current penetration test summary from an independent third party
- Confirmation that all data is stored and processed within the EU
- A signed Data Processing Agreement based on our template, compliant with the Dutch Government Information Security Baseline (BIO)

The deadline for submissions is five weeks from today. Please confirm your intention to bid and nominate a contact person for questions.

With kind regards,
Ingrid de Vries
Procurement Officer, Gemeente Westerland

Subject: Contractors locked out after enforcing SSO

We turned on "Require SSO" yesterday. Our 6 contractors don't have accounts in our IdP, so now they can't log in at all. Is there a way to exempt specific users from SSO enforcement? They're blocked on a deliverable due tomorrow.

Subject: Switching from SMS to authenticator app

I'd like to move my two-factor from SMS to an authenticator app since I travel a lot and don't always get texts. I can't find where to change it in settings. Can you point me to it?

Subject: Slack slash command error

The /task command in Slack returns "dispatch_failed" for everyone. The rest of the Slack integration (notifications) still works. We reinstalled the Slack app with no luck.

Subject: Payment failed + remove users

Our renewal payment failed. We're updating the card now. Before the next attempt, please remove 6 inactive users so we're charged for fewer seats. The workspace is harborview-dental.ourapp.com.

Subject: Charged twice this month

Looking at my bank statement I see two charges of $15.00 from you on the 3rd, a few minutes apart. I only have one account. Can you refund the duplicate? Email on the account: noor.haddad@gmail.com

Subject: Keyboard shortcuts

Is there a list of keyboard shortcuts? I'm looking specifically for how to quickly move a task to the next column without the mouse.
Hello, how can I make a copy of a task with all its subtasks and put it in a different project? I do the same checklist every month for each new client.

Subject: API usage stats

Is there a way to see our API usage (calls per day, per token)? We think one of our integrations is making far too many calls, but we can't tell which one.
The billing page says "Payment method required" but I already have a card saved. It won't accept it as the default. Our plan renews tomorrow.
I want to delete my account but I'm the only admin in a workspace with 5 other people. What happens to them if I delete? I don't want to leave them stranded.

Subject: Competitive pricing

A competitor has quoted us $8 per user per month for 100 users. Your Business plan is $14. Is there any flexibility? We prefer your product but the price difference is hard to justify to our CFO.

Subject: Export time entries

Where can I export all time entries for last quarter as a CSV? I only see an option to export tasks, not time. Our accountant needs it by Friday.

Subject: Outage last night?

Was there an outage around 2am UTC last night? Our overnight team in Manila said they couldn't access anything for about 40 minutes. Everything is fine now. Just want to know what happened so I can report it internally.

Subject: Trial ends but no card on file

My trial ends in 3 days. I didn't enter a card. Do I need to do anything to stop it, or will it just stop? I'm still deciding whether to keep using it.

Subject: Approvers role

We want a role for our legal reviewers that can view tasks and add comments or approvals, but can't create or edit tasks. Does that exist? The Viewer role doesn't allow comments.

Subject: Authenticator codes rejected

My Google Authenticator codes are being rejected as invalid. They were working yesterday. I have not changed phones. The codes look normal, 6 digits. Account: acct_9mq22x

Subject: Credit note needed

You refunded $240 to us last week for the seats we removed, thank you. For our accounts I need a formal credit note referencing the original invoice (INV-60775). The refund confirmation email isn't enough for our auditors.
trial ended but i was on holiday for most of it. can i get another week?

Subject: Update card - account suspended

I'm trying to update our card but I can't log in to the billing page because the account is suspended for non-payment. Catch-22! How can I pay if I can't get in? My email is oskar.lind@nordvik.no

Subject: Your LinkedIn profile

Hi! I noticed your company page on LinkedIn and wanted to connect. We offer outsourced software development at competitive rates. Let me know if you'd like to hear more.

Feature request: I'd like to be able to choose which day the weekly digest email arrives. Monday morning is the worst time for us, Friday afternoon would be better. Also, it'd be nice to choose which projects are included.
End of trial and our company just froze all purchases until the new fiscal year (6 weeks). Any chance of an extended trial or a free tier with our data kept?

Subject: Stored XSS in task descriptions

Hello security team,

I'm an independent security researcher and I'd like to report what I believe is a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in your web application.

When a task description is edited through the rich-text editor and contains a specially crafted link with a javascript: URL inside an HTML entity-encoded attribute, the sanitiser doesn't neutralise it. When another user opens the task and hovers over the link, the script runs in their session. In my testing, using two accounts I own in a workspace I created, I was able to read the victim's session-bound API responses.

I have not accessed any data belonging to other customers, and I've kept the proof of concept strictly within my own test workspace. I'm happy to share full reproduction steps and the payload through a secure channel. Could you let me know the right contact and whether you run a bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure programme? I'll hold off on any public disclosure until you've had a reasonable time to fix it.

Regards,
Nikhil Varma

Subject: Card declined + double charge?

Our card was declined for this month's renewal, so I paid manually with another card. But now I see two charges on the new card, both for $240. Can you check whether we paid twice and refund one if so? acct_dd2140
my payment failed and now i'm locked out of editing, only view mode. i updated the card 10 min ago. how long until i can edit again? i'm in the middle of a project for a client

Our team uses Google Workspace, and since last week all of your notification emails go to spam. Google shows "This message failed authentication". Other companies' emails are fine. Workspace: juniper-hr.ourapp.com

love the new dark mode!! finally. thank you

Bug: subtasks marked done reappear as not done after refresh.

Your signup allows passwords like "password1" and "12345678". For a product holding business data, that's a weak policy. Consider checking against breached-password lists and requiring a minimum strength.

We downgraded to Pro last week and now I can't see any of the dashboards we built on Business. I know dashboards are a Business feature but I assumed they'd be read-only, not gone. Can we get read-only access or export them? Otherwise we'll have to go back up to Business.
We need to remove 3 people who left and add 2 new hires. Since that brings us down by one seat overall, can we also reduce our plan from 15 seats to 14 at the same time? Workspace ID ws_52291.
App gets slower the longer I keep the tab open. After a few hours it's crawling. Refreshing fixes it. Memory leak?

We're moving ~40 boards from Trello. Is there an importer that keeps card comments and attachments? Tried the JSON import on one board and the attachments came through as broken links. Also, will checklists be preserved? We'd like to switch over this weekend.

Hi, I think you're the company that makes the Kanban whiteboards? I want to order two magnetic boards for our office. What sizes do you have?

Subject: Receipts for expense system

Our expense system needs receipts as PDF attachments, not links. Can the monthly receipt email include the PDF directly? Right now I have to log in every month to download it.
Duplicate tasks keep appearing, identical copies with the same title and description. We've deleted the duplicates twice and they come back. What's creating them?

Subject: OUTAGE - entire team blocked

Nothing loads for anyone in our company since about 8:15am Eastern. We get a blank page and then "Unable to connect". Our IT team confirmed it's not our network, other sites work fine. We have 200 people who can't work and a client deliverable at noon. Your status page shows all systems operational, which is clearly wrong. Please give us an update ASAP. Org ID 77120.
How do I stop getting emails when someone reacts to my comment with an emoji? I still want replies, just not reactions.

We've been monitoring response times on your REST API. The p95 latency for GET /v2/tasks has gone from about 200ms to 2.5s over the past week. No errors, just much slower. This is making our sync jobs run 10x longer. Example request ID from a slow call: req_91ad7e03. Any changes on your side?

Someone got into my account. They changed my name to "lol" and deleted two of my projects. I've changed my password but I'm scared they still have access. Please help me secure it and get my projects back. My email is carlos.rivas@protonmail.com

Subject: Cancel but keep free account

I want to cancel my paid Pro plan but keep using the free plan. Will my projects still be there? I have about 15 projects, I think the free plan allows 5. What happens to the other 10?
Please permanently delete my account and all my data. I've already cancelled. Email: rafael.silva@terra.com.br

Everything was fine until today's update. Now whenever I open a task that has more than about 50 comments, the page freezes and Chrome asks if I want to wait or kill the page. Tasks with fewer comments open normally. Unfortunately our most important tasks are the ones with lots of discussion.
Is there a way to stop regular members from creating new projects? We keep ending up with dozens of half-empty projects. I want only admins to be able to create them.

When I try to add a new card in the billing page I get "Error PMT-422: card could not be verified". I've tried two different cards from two different banks. Both work fine elsewhere. Our payment is overdue now so this is getting stressful.

Can you check whether something happened on your end, and whether the last three weeks of changes can be recovered? I'm really worried we've lost them.

Org ID 18803.

Thanks,
Ben Achterberg
Head of Product

When I set a due date using the date picker, it saves as the day before. E.g. I pick the 20th, it shows the 19th. Started happening this week. I'm in New Zealand (UTC+13) if that's relevant.

I also want to turn on 2FA with an authenticator app, but the option is greyed out. Email: pablo.medina@gmx.es

Our team's email notifications show every task as "Untitled task" since yesterday. Also, in the web app, task titles with an ampersand show "&" instead. Looks like an encoding issue in both places?
Is my subscription cancelled? I asked in chat last week and the bot said it would be done but I never got an email confirming it and it still shows active. Ticket was #57120 I think.

Subject: Suspicious activity in our workspace

Hello,

Our admin noticed this morning that a user account belonging to one of our project managers, who's currently on leave, was active overnight between 01:00 and 04:00 our time. In that window the account exported three projects to CSV, invited two external email addresses as guests, and changed the notification settings for several shared projects so updates would go to one of those external addresses.

We've suspended the user and removed the guests, but we need your help to understand the full scope. Specifically: can you give us the IP addresses and user agents for that session, confirm whether any API tokens were created, and tell us whether any other accounts in our workspace show similar activity? We'll need to report this internally and possibly to a regulator, so a detailed timeline would be very helpful.

Our org ID is 40718 and the affected user is l.moreau@altamed-group.fr.

Thank you,
Sébastien Garnier
IT Security Officer, Altamed Group

Subject: Feedback on the redesign

Hello,

I've been using your product daily for about four years, mostly for managing our agency's client projects, and I've recommended it to at least a dozen people. I'm writing because the redesign that rolled out last month has made my days noticeably harder, and I suspect I'm not the only one.

The main problems for me: the sidebar now collapses by default, so every time I open the app I have to expand it again; the project list is sorted by "recent" instead of alphabetically, so projects jump around and I click the wrong one; and the task detail panel opens as a full page instead of on the side, so I lose sight of the board.

Individually these are small, but together they add a lot of friction to something I do hundreds of times a day. I'm not asking for a refund or anything like that, and I'm not planning to leave. I just hope the product team hears from long-time users, not only from new ones.

Thanks for reading,
Claire Dubois
Founder, Studio Lumen

I noticed that some of your emails come from notifications@ourapp.com and others from a different sending domain, mail.ourapp-notify.com. The second one seems to be the one failing. Could your email team check your SPF and DMARC setup for that sending domain? It's also possible our new domain's security settings are stricter, but we'd need your list of sending IPs and domains to allowlist.

Org ID: 81123

Thank you,
Aidan Walsh
IT Infrastructure Lead
